title: नरेन्द्र कोहली के साहित्य में “समष्टि परिवार” एक दृष्टिकोण
nepali: प्राचीन काल से लेकर आज तक समाज के स्वरूप में अनेक परिवर्तन हुए हैं । प्रत्येक काल में समाज अपनी सामाजिक, आर्थिक, राजनितिक, धार्मिक परिस्थितियों को उजागर करता है । समाज का स्वरूप इसी पर आधारित है । आज की प्रस्तुत समस्या व्यष्टिवादिता है । अहं ने मनुष्यको “मैं” में जीना सिखा दिखा दिया है । परिवार विघटित होता नजर आ रहा है । पारिवारिक विघटन को रोकने का नरेन्द्र कोहली अपने साहित्य में सतत प्रयास करते है । वह अपनी उपन्यास, कहानी तथा व्यंग्य रचनाओं मे परिवार को एक नया आयाम देते है, जो आगे आनेवाली पीढियों के मार्ग को प्रशस्त करती है एवम् जीवन जीने के तरीके को एक नया स्वरूप प्रदान करती है ।
american_english: From ancient times to the present day, many changes have taken place in the form of society. In every age, society brings to light its social, economic, political and religious circumstances. The form of society is based on these. The present problem today is individualism. The ego has taught man to live in the 'I'. The family is seen to be falling apart. Narendra Kohli makes continuous efforts in his literature to stop family disintegration. In his novels, stories and satirical works, he gives the family a new dimension, which clears the path for future generations and gives a new form to the way of living life.
british_english: From ancient times right up to today, numerous changes have taken place in the form of society. In every age, society brings its social, economic, political and religious circumstances into relief. The shape of society rests upon this. Today's presenting problem is individualism. The ego has taught man to live in the 'I'. The family is seen to be disintegrating. Narendra Kohli labours ceaselessly in his literature to arrest family disintegration. In his novels, stories and satirical works he lends the family a new dimension, one that clears the way for the generations to come and bestows a new form upon the manner of living life.
australian_english: From ancient times right through to today, society's shape has changed many times over. Every age, society brings its social, economic, political and religious circumstances out into the open. The shape of society rests on exactly that. The problem staring us in the face today is individualism. The ego has taught people to live in the 'me'. The family looks like it's falling apart. Narendra Kohli keeps working away in his literature to stop families breaking up. In his novels, stories and satirical pieces he gives the family a new dimension, one that opens the way for the generations coming through and gives a new shape to the way people live their lives.
informal_english: From way back in ancient times right up to now, society's shape has changed plenty of times. Every age, society shows off its social, economic, political and religious circumstances. The shape of society sits on exactly that. The problem we're facing today is individualism. The ego has taught people to live in the 'me'. The family looks like it's falling apart. Narendra Kohli keeps grafting away in his literature to stop families from breaking up. In his novels, stories and satirical pieces he gives the family a new dimension, one that opens the road for the generations coming through and gives a fresh shape to the way people live their lives.
translator_notes: The abstract is written in Hindi rather than Nepali, though it appears in a NepJOL record; translated faithfully with strict sentence order preserved. 'व्यष्टिवादिता' rendered as 'individualism' and 'अहं' as 'ego'. The source shows an OCR artefact in 'सिखा दिखा दिया', read as 'सिखा दिया' ('has taught').
